name: Calling Names
overview: Scripture reveals the profound impact of our words, especially in how we address others. Proverbs teaches that careless or malicious speech can harm neighbors, while wisdom encourages restraint and peace. The tongue holds the power of life and death, with harsh words stirring anger, but gentle answers promoting harmony. True honor lies in avoiding strife, demonstrating that calling names or engaging in foolish disputes contradicts the Christlike path of understanding and love.
